title: The Lord’s Supper
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Only what Luke 22:14-20 says is asked. How each church celebrates the Lord's Supper is for the child's own church, not for marks.

skills.key_step: The child describes Luke 22:14-20: at the Passover Jesus eats with the apostles, takes bread, gives thanks, breaks it, "This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me", and the cup, "the new covenant in my blood"; explains why Christians remember it and the values it needs (respect, forgiveness, unity), without asking how a church celebrates it.

floor.question: Why do Christians celebrate Easter?
floor.answer: To remember Jesus' death and resurrection

representations: bread and a cup drawn on a table
steps: Jesus eats the Passover with the apostles.
He gives thanks and breaks bread.
He says "do this in remembrance of me".
He gives the cup of the new covenant.

board.do: Draw bread and a cup on a table.

board.say: What did Jesus say to do with it?

board.do: Wait for the child to say do this in remembrance of me.

listen_for: Only one name is correct and the others are wrong
misconceptions.ask: Churches call the Lord's Supper by different names. Which is true?
misconceptions.repair: Ask your own church's name and the names other churches use.

listen_for: With a crowd of five thousand
misconceptions.ask: With whom did Jesus share the Passover meal in Luke 22?

listen_for: Do this as a prize for the best behaved
